day_shape: 97 items: Khamenei funeral mobilisation dominates regime channels with 40 foreign delegations and 15-20 million expected, indirect US-Iran technical talks confirmed in Doha via Qatar/Pakistan, Iran oil exports at 1.66m bpd post-blockade, UK pledges £23m to UNRWA.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral logistics and mobilisation
threads.summary: Iranian state broadcaster IRIB and IRGC-linked Defa Press ran extensive coverage of funeral arrangements for slain Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, including airport closures, metro and rail allocations, a Tehran public holiday on 16 Tir, and release of 850 prisoners. Regime spokespeople claimed 15-20 million attendees and officials from 40 countries, while a leaked security directive urged media to avoid spotlighting political disputes during coverage.

threads.label: US-Iran indirect talks in Doha
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post cited Reuters reporting indirect US-Iran technical talks underway in Doha with Qatar and Pakistan mediating, while Qatar's Foreign Ministry publicly confirmed continuing negotiations despite no high-level meetings. Separate Jerusalem Post reporting said Trump is considering a return to war but sticking with diplomacy, and cited an internal power struggle between Iran's civilian leadership and IRGC over frozen funds and Hormuz.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz shipping and oil exports
threads.summary: Tanker Trackers reported Iran has exported 50 million barrels of crude since the US blockade was lifted two weeks ago, averaging 1.66m bpd for June. Jerusalem Post cited Western diplomats on an Omani counter-proposal for governing Hormuz, IRIB reported a foreign vessel running aground in the strait, and Defa Press quoted the IMO Secretary General as awaiting Iranian permission to remove ships.

threads.label: IDF strikes in Gaza and Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF announced the killing of Yibna Battalion commander Mohammad Fathi Abd al-Hay Abu Fakher in Rafah, four additional Hamas operatives in northern Gaza over the past week, and a Hezbollah operative near Manzleh in southern Lebanon. Netanyahu said IDF forces will remain in the Lebanon security zone until Hezbollah no longer poses a threat.

threads.label: Gaza settlement and migration plans
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported Smotrich saying the IDF should seize more than the 70% of Gaza it controls and that plans for three north Gaza settlements are finalised pending Netanyahu approval. Netanyahu said 'voluntary migration' from Gaza remains on the table and declined to rule out renewed Jewish settlement.

threads.label: Iranian defence posture and threats
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB carried repeated statements from Acting Defence Minister Ibn al-Reza and SNSC secretary Zolqadr that Iran's missile and drone capabilities are non-negotiable and that perpetrators of the strikes will face retribution. Netanyahu told Channel 14 a third confrontation with Iran was possible 'if necessary', and Israel's Defense Minister Katz sanctioned 37 cryptocurrency wallets linked to the IRGC.

threads.label: UK and international humanitarian pledges
threads.summary: The UK announced £23 million in additional funding to UNRWA at the UN pledging conference, with Ambassador James Kariuki describing the agency as indispensable for Palestinian refugees in Gaza and the region. UN Special Rapporteur Mai Sato said the US-Iran memorandum failed to address human rights, and Germany's domestic intelligence agency listed Iran among top foreign espionage threats in 2025.

events.summary_en: Announcement of traffic measures for the funeral ceremony of the martyred leader of the revolution. Deputy Mayor of Tehran on how to manage traffic for the farewell ceremony of the martyred leader of the revolution: In parking complexes at the 14 entrances to Tehran, we have designated over one million and 200,000 parking spaces. On the eve of the funeral of the martyred leader of the revolution and his final farewell to the people, measures have been considered. events.title_en: Head of Atomic Energy Organisation emphasises accelerating the implementation of wastewater treatment project using plasma technology
events.summary_en: Head of Atomic Energy Organisation emphasises accelerating the implementation of wastewater treatment project using plasma technology. The Head of Iran's Atomic Energy Organisation visited the construction process of an industrial wastewater treatment plant based on cold plasma technology in Kaveh Industrial City and Special Economic Zone. According to a report from the Centre for Public Diplomacy and Information of Iran's Atomic Energy Organisation; Mohammad Eslami, Vice President and Head of the Atomic Energy Organisation, visited the construction process of an industrial wastewater treatment plant based on cold plasma technology in Kaveh Industrial City and Special Economic Zone. During this visit, the Head of Iran's Atomic Energy Organisation reviewed different sections of the project including the EDR shed, balancing structure and the plasma unit.

events.title_en: Allocation of urban and suburban trains for the martyr leader's funeral ceremony; train movement schedule. Managing Director of Railways:
events.summary_en: Allocation of urban and suburban trains for the martyr leader's funeral ceremony; train movement schedule. Managing Director of Railways: Regular and special trains on the routes to Tehran, Qom and Mashhad have been allocated for the funeral and mourning ceremony of Iran's martyred leader. Special trains to Tehran will be despatched on Monday and Tuesday, special trains to Qom on Tuesday and Wednesday, and special trains to Mashhad on Wednesday and Thursday. Additionally, for the return of passengers, special trains have been planned for Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday. Online sales of remaining train capacity will begin at 2 pm today.

events.title_en: Thursday, 18 Tir; national mourning throughout the country / Tuesday, 16 Tir Tehran is closed
events.summary_en: Thursday, 18 Tir; national mourning throughout the country / Tuesday, 16 Tir Tehran is closed. Fatima Mohajerani, Government Spokesperson, announced: The Cabinet today (Wednesday) decided that in order to facilitate the departure of mourners of the martyred leader of the Islamic revolution, His Eminence Ayatollah Khamenei, from Tehran, Tuesday, 16 Tir of this city will be a public holiday. events.title_en: Details of airport closures during the funeral ceremony of the martyred leader of the revolution. Head of Civil Aviation Organisation:
events.summary_en: Details of airport closures during the funeral ceremony of the martyred leader of the revolution. Head of Civil Aviation Organisation: Concurrent with the farewell and funeral ceremony of the martyred leader of the revolution, Mehrabad Airport is closed on Friday and only diplomatic and political flights are conducted. Imam Khomeini Airport will operate normally on that day. The following Monday the Tehran airspace and the airspace of Mehrabad and Imam Khomeini airports will be completely closed and no flights will be conducted. On Tuesday, Mehrabad Airport will return to normal operations, but Imam Khomeini Airport will remain closed due to the transfer of the martyred leader's body to Iraq. The 18th of Tir also.
